nodes.title: Positive Prompt
widgets_values: natural documentary photography of a middle-aged bicycle mechanic with grease-marked hands pausing before beginning the next task inside a modest neighborhood repair shop. medium shot at eye level with natural breathing room; soft overcast daylight with gentle tonal separation. Captured with modern smartphone main camera with restrained computational processing; 4:5 portrait; fine natural sensor grain and realistic tonal transitions. Visible details: natural skin texture, ordinary clothing wear, credible posture. Constraints: anatomically natural people and hands, believable gaze and spacing, no duplicated faces, no added caption, no watermark; incidental background text may be present but must not be prominent or branded.
